summary_en: Tokai Soft announced an execution of treasury stock acquisition of up to 60,000 shares at a fixed price of 1,662 yen per share on November 5, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3, representing 1.25% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock, for a maximum amount of 99.72 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Market Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 4, 2026, Tokai Soft's board of directors authorized an immediate execution of treasury stock acquisition via off-market transaction (ToSTNeT-3) on the following business day. The company will purchase up to 60,000 shares of its own common stock at a fixed price of 1,662 yen per share, which was the closing price on November 4, 2026 including final special quotations. The purchase order will be submitted on November 5, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. Tokyo time during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading session.

The maximum acquisition amount is 99.72 million yen, representing 1.25% of shares outstanding (calculated from 60,000 shares divided by 4,797,017 shares in issue excluding treasury stock). The company stated the purpose is to conduct flexible capital policy in response to changes in the operating environment. The acquisition results will be announced after the trading session ends at 8:45 a.m.
